h: Obidient mobiliser Serah Ibrahim backs Makinde's presidential bid
p: Serah Ibrahim, a well-known grassroots mobiliser linked to the Obidient Movement, has reportedly endorsed Oyo governor Seyi Makinde for president and says she helped write his Reset Agenda. Peter Obi responded by calling her his daughter.
body: Serah Ibrahim, a grassroots mobiliser widely associated with Peter Obi's Obidient Movement, has publicly backed Oyo State governor Seyi Makinde's bid for the presidency.

According to reports, Ibrahim appeared at the Allied Peoples Movement's presidential manifesto event in Abuja, where she introduced Makinde to the audience and described him as the most outstanding Nigerian on the ballot. She said she had helped develop his presidential policy document, called the Reset Agenda, which focuses on the economy, security, education and governance.

Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, addressed speculation about a rift with Ibrahim in a video, describing her as his daughter. He did not criticise her decision.

Ibrahim became prominent during Obi's 2023 campaign as a Labour Party mobiliser. Makinde, who is completing his second term as Oyo governor, is the APM's presidential candidate for 2027. The opposition is split between several candidates, including Obi of the NDC and Atiku Abubakar of the ADC, while President Bola Tinubu seeks a second term on the APC platform. Several of Makinde's own officials have resigned from his government in recent weeks.
Some Obi supporters criticised Ibrahim, while others said she was free to support any candidate. Makinde's supporters welcomed her backing.
more: Ibrahim says she helped write Makinde's Reset Agenda.
Obi described her as his daughter.
Makinde is the APM presidential candidate.
